sbe9b71bf6a2b98: HAMi’s equipment is designed in the abstract to be central to its ability to respond quickly to physical ecological changes and maintain a strong heterogeneous utility resourceces tube capability. By defining a clear, rights-based interface, it “sunk” the hardware’s fit complexity and encapsulates it into its own equipment.
s53dc811237421e: Enflame GCU’s integrated case is a strong example of the structure’s superiority: developers need not understand the internal cycle and complexity of HAMi Scheduler, but focus on achieving several well-defined functions that will enable them to access a new heterogeneous hardware quickly and reliably into the claud-nativescheduling system. Not only does it reduce the fit costs for manufacturers, but it also greatly stimulates community enthusiasm for contributions.
